name: zero-memory
description: Persistent cross-session memory for Codex: auto-briefing at session start, a health warning when the server is unreachable, transcript auto-capture on stop, and the memory-first working skill. The zero-memory MCP server (recall, build_context, remember) is registered by `codex mcp add` at user scope, keeping plain tool names (a plugin-bundled server would namespace them).
